ctx.x: Did you ever play any parades or have a brass band with that group too?

I don't know. I played in different brass bands, but not with the Young Tuxedo. That's John Kazmi. I worked with every brass band around here, such as… The first man started me into brass band work was Ernest Rapania, the old drummer. Oh, yes. And that was… I was doing them same music in the 20s. And… But you played with him…
Did you play bass or snare drum? I played the snare drum.
